summary: Iteration 32 — Stripe subscription wiring (Premium $29.99/mo, VIP $49.99/mo). All 15 backend pytest checks passed and all 4 critical frontend flows verified. Subscription products are auto-provisioned in Stripe at startup, persisted in db.settings, and the new /api/payments/subscribe + /api/me/subscription endpoints work end-to-end. Logged-in user successfully redirected to live Stripe Checkout (test stopped at the hosted page — no payment completed).

issues: Legacy $399 Progress Pass 12-month card still rendered on the dashboard (user noted this is REMAINING HAND-WORK — out of scope for this iteration).

(Future) Add email notifications on subscription.created / .updated / .deleted events.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 8005 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (subscriptions.py, payments.py, webhook.py, reports.py) to keep file <700 lines per the code-review guidelines.
`/api/payments/subscribe` correctly looks up the price_id server-side (no client-driven amount), idempotent product creation, and reuses existing stripe_customer_id when present — solid design.

Cancel endpoint returns 'Subscription already scheduled for cancellation' as 400 — that branch is unreachable for a no-sub user (correctly short-circuits on the first `if not sub_id` check). Behavior is correct.
Webhook handler validates Stripe signature before doing any work and rejects invalid signatures with 400 — verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe subscription provisioning is verified: db.settings has stripe_subscription_premium (price_1Tm9RePyHKLMizP3A9KbZHiz) and stripe_subscription_vip (price_1Tm9RePyHKLMizP3v0Si2CZi).
